title: This Is Your FBI
paragraphs: A dramatized crime series produced with FBI cooperation, presenting cases involving espionage, kidnapping, fraud, organized crime, and other federal investigations.
ABC fact-based federal crime drama made with documented FBI cooperation. Full run began April 6, 1945; the frozen GRH archive begins October 12, 1945 and ends with January 30, 1953.
GRH documents the program through ABC weekly run (April 6, 1945 to January 30, 1953) on [[org|org.0d7b5c86680811cc|ABC Radio Network]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Frederick Steiner (composer on 187 recordings, conductor on 186 recordings, music director on 16 recordings, and performer on 1 recording), Jerry Devine (producer on 196 recordings, writer on 28 recordings, director on 8 recordings, and performer on 1 recording), [[person|stacy-harris|Stacy Harris]] (performer on 162 recordings), Larry Keating (announcer on 156 recordings, host on 1 recording, narrator on 1 recording, and performer on 1 recording), William Woodson (narrator on 142 recordings, announcer on 1 recording, and performer on 1 recording), Jerry D.
